fusions.name: Cheap Shot
fusions.desc: A sly butt that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and has a 30% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Misdirected Charge
fusions.desc: Turns up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles against each other for 4 seconds, dealing 8 damage and knocking them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Slipped the Drover's Eye
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
